holes.body:
theorem complexProjectiveSpace_higher_homotopy_mulEquiv_sphere
    (n k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (k + 3) (ComplexProjectiveSpace n)
          (complexProjectiveBasepoint n) ≃*
        HomotopyGroup.Pi (k + 3) (SphereSpace (2 * n + 1))
          (sphereBasepoint (2 * n + 1))) := by
  sorry
